title: Colts Training Camp Day 3: ‘Find a way’ when opportunity knocks

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Colts Training Camp Day 3: ‘Find a way’ when opportunity knocks
sources.description: Find a way to make the roster. Find a way to make the play when it matters most. Find a way to fly through the turbulence, through adversity. Ultimately, the goal is to find a way back to the playoffs.
